reviews.comment: Dr. Annie Ruimi is a caring and fair professor. Her explaining is usually clear and simple to understand, and she's clear about what's needed. However, she sometimes assumes the whole class understands. Notes from slides and homework can be scruffy, but she's accessible and willing to help when needed.

Just no. She doesn't have your typical test reviews (with questions that help you prepare for a test); she would just tell the class what topics would be included and to look over homework and past quizzes. She does post key answers to homework and quizzes, but sometimes they don't make sense or are incorrect. :/

Makes calculation mistakes every class, has to check herself with the textbook to make sure she did the problem right, and is condescending upon students. She quite literally treats us like we are stupid and is ALWAYS annoyed. Idk why she chose this career to be so honest. thanks to TAMU arch department for not listening to any of the complaints
she ight, lil hard to understand tho

I did not like her. She's an engineering prof attempting to teach architecture structures. You can't understand her voice or writing, she gets mad at you all the time, will call you out, and her teaching is so unorganized it's hard to follow. I stopped going to class because I learned more from teaching myself than from her. Avoid her if you can...

This is a mechanical engineer professor coming in to teach an Architecture Structures class. Completely changed the course work/load from previous semesters. I am an architecture student having to ask engineers for help. Illegible handwriting most of the time. Hard to understand. Her answer keys are wrong a lot.

She is not good with technology at all, her handwriting is usually illegible, and it can be hard to understand her sometimes. Never gave good practice for exams. Most times the practice solutions would contradict themselves from the work that she did herself. I will say she cared about the students, but that doesn't make up for the difficulty.

Dr. Annie was difficult to understand at times, but was overall a great professor. If confused in her class, make sure to attend office hours as that cleared up all my problems. A lot of people skipped and didn't do the homework- they complained abt bad grades but they kinda asked for it. Take this class if you are willing to put in the work.

reviews.comment: She is AWFUL. Do not take. In class she will belittle you if you ask a question. She will tell you to figure out the problem, even if we have never seen the topic before. TA's will try to help but she will tell them to sit down and wait. She has been the worst teacher i have had.
